_comment: Word/phrase-level breakdown of Stardew Valley SpecialOrderStrings.xnb strings, for in-context mouse-over translation of individual pieces of a sentence (not a general Chinese-English dictionary -- glosses are chosen for how each word/phrase functions in THIS specific sentence). Each entry: "chinese" (exact source text), "english" (a natural-ish literal translation, for context), and "segments" -- an ordered array of {text, pinyin, gloss} whose "text" fields concatenate back to exactly reproduce "chinese" (validated by tools/segment-data/segtool.py).

Caroline_Text.chinese: 我想尝试烹饪热带菜肴，但是寻找食材真的很困难。如果有人能售出 100 份{Crop:TextPlural}，应该能帮上忙！
Caroline_Text.english: I want to try cooking tropical dishes, but finding ingredients is really difficult. If someone could sell 100 portions of {Crop:TextPlural}, that should help!

Clint_Text.chinese: 当地洞穴中的{Monster:LocalizedName}数量已经导致我……不对，是其他人——其他人采矿变得十分危险。凡是愿意杀死 50 只怪物的人都能得到一笔可观的报酬。——克林特
Clint_Text.english: The number of {Monster:LocalizedName} in the local caves has already caused me... no wait, other people -- other people's mining to become very dangerous. Anyone willing to kill 50 monsters can get a considerable payment. -- Clint

Demetrius2_Text.chinese: 本地的{FishType:Text}数量泛滥成灾，具体原因不明。我需要一名本地的垂钓者帮忙减少鱼群数量。
Demetrius2_Text.english: The number of local {FishType:Text} has flooded into a disaster, for unknown specific reasons. I need a local angler to help reduce the fish population.

Demetrius_Text.chinese: 本地的{FishType:Text}数量泛滥成灾，具体原因不明。我需要一名本地的垂钓者帮忙减少鱼群数量。
Demetrius_Text.english: The number of local {FishType:Text} has flooded into a disaster, for unknown specific reasons. I need a local angler to help reduce the fish population.

Emily_Objective_0_Text.chinese: 给艾米丽送一个红宝石

Emily_Objective_1_Text.chinese: 给艾米丽送一个黄水晶

Emily_Objective_2_Text.chinese: 给艾米丽送一个绿宝石

Emily_Objective_4_Text.chinese: 给艾米丽送一个紫水晶

Emily_Text.chinese: 嘿！我打算邀请一些朋友过来，办一个“宝石能量”仪式，但我需要一些水晶才能聚集相应的能量。你能帮把手吗？
Emily_Text.english: Hey! I plan to invite some friends over to hold a "gem energy" ritual, but I need some crystals to gather the corresponding energy. Can you lend a hand?

Evelyn_Objective_1_Text.chinese: 把韭葱放在艾芙琳的厨房里。
Evelyn_Objective_1_Text.english: Put the leeks in Evelyn's kitchen.

Evelyn_Text.chinese: 乔治认为镇子上没人在乎他，我想要证明他是错的！一打韭葱应该就足够了……他最喜欢韭葱了。——艾芙琳
Evelyn_Text.english: George thinks no one in town cares about him, I want to prove he's wrong! A dozen leeks should be enough... he likes leeks most. -- Evelyn

Gunther_Objective_0_Text.chinese: 把骨头放在博物馆柜台的投递箱里。
Gunther_Objective_0_Text.english: Put the bones in the drop box at the museum counter.

Gunther_Text.chinese: 全体古生物爱好者们！我的研究需要 100 块骨头。请把它们放在博物馆柜台！——冈瑟
Gunther_Text.english: All paleontology enthusiasts! My research needs 100 pieces of bone. Please put them at the museum counter! -- Gunther

Gus_Objective_1_Text.chinese: 把蛋放到格斯的冰箱里。
Gus_Objective_1_Text.english: Put the eggs in Gus's fridge.

Gus_RE_Greeting_0.chinese: 我想要做一份我出了名的巨型煎蛋卷
Gus_RE_Greeting_0.english: I want to make one of my famous giant omelettes

Gus_RE_Greeting_1.chinese: 我想要再做一份巨型煎蛋卷
Gus_RE_Greeting_1.english: I want to make another giant omelette

Gus_Text.chinese: {Greeting}……我需要 24 个蛋。有人帮忙吗？——格斯
Gus_Text.english: {Greeting}... I need 24 eggs. Anyone help? -- Gus

Lewis_RE_Text_0.english: This year the demand for {Crop:TextPlural} is very large.

Lewis_RE_Text_1.chinese: {Crop:TextPlural}在祖祖市似乎得到了最新的“健康食物”称号。
Lewis_RE_Text_1.english: {Crop:TextPlural} seem to have gotten the newest "health food" title in Zuzu City.

Lewis_RE_Text_2.chinese: 祖祖市掀起了一股新的美容热潮……据说，一种由{Crop:Text}制成的乳液可以去除皱纹。
Lewis_RE_Text_2.english: Zuzu City has stirred up a new beauty craze... reportedly, a lotion made from {Crop:Text} can remove wrinkles.

Lewis_RE_Text_3.chinese: 最近有人看到酱汁女王在吃新鲜的{Crop:Text}。现在全世界都想尝尝看！
Lewis_RE_Text_3.english: Recently someone saw the Queen of Sauce eating fresh {Crop:Text}. Now the whole world wants to taste it!

Lewis_RE_Text_4.chinese: 州长正在举行宴会，他的厨师订购了大量的{Crop:TextPlural}。
Lewis_RE_Text_4.english: The governor is holding a banquet, and his chefs have ordered a large amount of {Crop:TextPlural}.

Lewis_Text.chinese: {Text}所有在本季度结束前售出 100 份{Crop:TextPlural}的人都将获得一份由鹈鹕镇农业基金提供的丰厚奖励。
Lewis_Text.english: {Text} Everyone who sells 100 portions of {Crop:TextPlural} before the end of this season will receive a generous reward provided by the Pelican Town Agricultural Fund.

Linus_Objective_1_Text.chinese: 把垃圾倒在火车站台后面的回收桶里。
Linus_Objective_1_Text.english: Dump the trash in the recycling bin behind the train platform.

Linus_Text.chinese: 我有个主意。水里有很多垃圾，我们为什么不钓一些出来，使山谷更美丽呢？——莱纳斯
Linus_Text.english: I have an idea. There's a lot of trash in the water, why don't we fish some out and make the valley more beautiful? -- Linus

Marlon_DF_0_Text.chinese: 进入骷髅洞穴，杀掉 10 只{Monster:LocalizedName}。
Marlon_DF_0_Text.english: Enter the Skull Cavern and kill 10 {Monster:LocalizedName}.

Marlon_DF_1_Objective.chinese: 到达骷髅洞穴第 30 层。
Marlon_DF_1_Objective.english: Reach floor 30 of the Skull Cavern.

Marlon_DF_1_Text.chinese: 到达骷髅洞穴第 30 层。
Marlon_DF_1_Text.english: Reach floor 30 of the Skull Cavern.

Marlon_DF_2_Text.chinese: 在骷髅洞穴中收集 {Treasure:Count} 个{Treasure:LocalizedName}。

Pam_Objective_0_Text.chinese: 在小桶里装一些土豆，收集 12 桶。
Pam_Objective_0_Text.english: Put some potatoes in kegs, collect 12 kegs.

Pam_Objective_1_Text.chinese: 把东西放在潘姆的厨房里。
Pam_Objective_1_Text.english: Put the stuff in Pam's kitchen.

Pam_Text.chinese: 我听说有一种用土豆做的烈酒，超级猛——你懂的。可以帮我在小桶里放一点土豆，然后给我送来几桶吗？
Pam_Text.english: I heard there's a strong liquor made from potatoes, super potent -- you know. Can you help me put a bit of potato in a keg, then bring me a few kegs?

Pierre_Objective_1_Text.chinese: 把农作物放进皮埃尔商店里的空箱子中。
Pierre_Objective_1_Text.english: Put the crops into the empty box in Pierre's store.

Pierre_Text.chinese: 你好。为了即将到来的促销活动，我打算售卖一些价格稍高的高品质蔬菜……考虑到我是节俭的店主，有谁知道哪里可以找到 25 份金星品质的蔬菜吗？
Pierre_Text.english: Hello. For the upcoming promotion, I plan to sell some slightly pricier high-quality vegetables... considering I'm a frugal shopkeeper, does anyone know where to find 25 gold-star-quality vegetables?

QiChallenge10_Objective_0_Text.chinese: 在骷髅洞穴抵达 100 层。
QiChallenge10_Objective_0_Text.english: Reach floor 100 in the Skull Cavern.

QiChallenge10_Text.chinese: 骷髅洞穴受到强大怪物的入侵。安全抵达 100 层吧。
QiChallenge10_Text.english: The Skull Cavern has been invaded by powerful monsters. Reach floor 100 safely.

QiChallenge11_Text.chinese: 有另一个我藏在镇上的某个地方。你能抓住他吗？
QiChallenge11_Text.english: There's another me hidden somewhere in town. Can you catch him?

QiChallenge12_Objective_0_Text.chinese: 把 100 个红色的物品放进齐先生的收集箱里。
QiChallenge12_Objective_0_Text.english: Put 100 red items into Mr. Qi's collection box.

QiChallenge12_Objective_1_Text.chinese: 把 100 个橙色的物品放进齐先生的收集箱里。
QiChallenge12_Objective_1_Text.english: Put 100 orange items into Mr. Qi's collection box.

QiChallenge12_Objective_2_Text.chinese: 把 100 个黄色的物品放进齐先生的收集箱里。
QiChallenge12_Objective_2_Text.english: Put 100 yellow items into Mr. Qi's collection box.

QiChallenge12_Objective_3_Text.chinese: 把 100 个绿色的物品放进齐先生的收集箱里。
QiChallenge12_Objective_3_Text.english: Put 100 green items into Mr. Qi's collection box.

QiChallenge12_Objective_4_Text.chinese: 把 100 个蓝色的物品放进齐先生的收集箱里。
QiChallenge12_Objective_4_Text.english: Put 100 blue items into Mr. Qi's collection box.

QiChallenge12_Objective_5_Text.chinese: 把 100 个紫色的物品放进齐先生的收集箱里。
QiChallenge12_Objective_5_Text.english: Put 100 purple items into Mr. Qi's collection box.

QiChallenge12_Text.chinese: 找到红色、橙色、黄色、绿色、蓝色、紫色的物品各 100 个，把它们放进我的收集箱里。
QiChallenge12_Text.english: Find 100 each of red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple items, and put them into my collection box.

QiChallenge2_Text.chinese: 我把齐豆藏到了世界各地。把它们找出来，然后种下去，在期限内售出 500 个齐瓜。
QiChallenge2_Text.english: I've hidden Qi beans all over the world. Find them, then plant them, and sell 500 Qi melons within the time limit.

QiChallenge3_Objective_0_Text.chinese: 在祝尼魔赛车无限模式下得 5 万分。
QiChallenge3_Objective_0_Text.english: Score 50,000 points in Junimo Kart endless mode.

QiChallenge3_Text.chinese: 你能在祝尼魔赛车无限模式下得 5 万分吗？证明给我看。
QiChallenge3_Text.english: Can you score 50,000 points in Junimo Kart endless mode? Prove it to me.

QiChallenge4_Objective_0_Text.chinese: 把 4 个五彩碎片放到齐先生的收集箱里。
QiChallenge4_Objective_0_Text.english: Put 4 prismatic shards into Mr. Qi's collection box.

QiChallenge4_Text.chinese: 找到 4 个五彩碎片。放到我的收集箱里。
QiChallenge4_Text.english: Find 4 prismatic shards. Put them into my collection box.

QiChallenge5_Objective_0_Text.chinese: 在骷髅洞穴到达 100 层。
QiChallenge5_Objective_0_Text.english: Reach floor 100 in the Skull Cavern.

QiChallenge5_Text.chinese: 你的任务是在骷髅洞穴到达 100 层，而且不能吃不能喝。
QiChallenge5_Text.english: Your task is to reach floor 100 in the Skull Cavern, and you can't eat or drink.

QiChallenge6_Objective_0_Text.chinese: 售出价值 100,000 金的新鲜烹饪食品。
QiChallenge6_Objective_0_Text.english: Sell freshly cooked food worth 100,000 gold.

QiChallenge6_Text.chinese: 售出价值 100,000 金的新鲜烹饪食品。
QiChallenge6_Text.english: Sell freshly cooked food worth 100,000 gold.

QiChallenge7_Objective_0_Text.chinese: 在一周内送出 50 份受喜爱的礼物。
QiChallenge7_Objective_0_Text.english: Give 50 loved gifts within one week.

QiChallenge7_Text.chinese: 在一周内送出 50 份受喜爱的礼物。
QiChallenge7_Text.english: Give 50 loved gifts within one week.

QiChallenge8_Objective_2_Text.english: Catch the son of the crimson fish.

QiChallenge8_Objective_4_Text.english: Catch the legendary fish, second generation.

QiChallenge8_Text.chinese: 传说鱼类的家族成员回到了山谷里。你要在三天内捕捉到雌鮟鱇鱼、小冰川鱼、绯红鱼之子、放射性鲤鱼，还有传说之鱼二代。
QiChallenge8_Text.english: Family members of the legendary fish have come back to the valley. You must catch the female anglerfish, the little glacier fish, the son of the crimson fish, the radioactive carp, and the legendary fish II within three days.

QiChallenge9_Objective_0_Text.english: Reach the bottom of the mine again.

QiChallenge9_Text.chinese: 矿井的电梯系统已重置，地底深处出现了新的危险。在一周内到达矿井底部。
QiChallenge9_Text.english: The mine's elevator system has been reset, and new dangers have appeared deep underground. Reach the bottom of the mine within one week.

QiChallenge_Text.chinese: 我会给你 600 个齐豆。把它们种下去，好好栽培，然后在一周指内给售出至少 500 个果实。但要小心，五场灾害会降临，威胁到你的农作物……
QiChallenge_Text.english: I'll give you 600 Qi beans. Plant them, cultivate them well, then sell at least 500 fruits within one week. But be careful, five disasters will descend, threatening your crops...

Robin2_Text.chinese: 我想搞一次小小的促销活动，当然只是为了娱乐。如果有人能在一周内收集到 1000 份{Resource:Text}，就能获得一份奖赏。而且你可以留着收集到的{Resource:Text}！——罗宾
Robin2_Text.english: I want to run a small promotion, of course just for fun. If anyone can collect 1000 units of {Resource:Text} within one week, they can get a reward. And you can keep the {Resource:Text} you collected! -- Robin

Robin_Objective_1_Text.chinese: 把硬木放到罗宾房子的库存中。
Robin_Objective_1_Text.english: Put the hardwood into the stock at Robin's house.

Robin_Text.chinese: 嗨！我构思了一种新造型的床，但我需要 80 块硬木才能做出来。有人能帮把手吗？——罗宾
Robin_Text.english: Hi! I've conceived a new style of bed, but I need 80 pieces of hardwood to make it. Can anyone lend a hand? -- Robin

Willy2_Text.chinese: 在热带地区钓鱼的体验是无与伦比的……为了让这项技艺得到传承，所有带来大量岛屿渔获的人都能得到我的奖励。
Willy2_Text.english: The experience of fishing in the tropics is unmatched... to let this craft be passed on, everyone who brings a big island catch can get my reward.

Willy_Objective_1_Text.chinese: 把虫肉放进威利房子旁边的桶里。
Willy_Objective_1_Text.english: Put the bug meat into the barrel next to Willy's house.

Willy_Text.chinese: 你好啊，我需要大量的虫子内脏。越多汁越好……至少，螃蟹似乎喜欢多汁的虫子……100 块应该就够用了。
Willy_Text.english: Hello, I need a large amount of bug guts. The juicier the better... at least, crabs seem to like juicy bugs... 100 pieces should be enough to use.

Wizard2_Objective_1_Message.chinese: 啊……你已经狩猎回来了。我感觉得到这是一次成功的狩猎！$h#$b#来，把胶冻给我然后就走吧！我还有重要的工作要做。
Wizard2_Objective_1_Message.english: Ah... you've already come back from the hunt. I can feel this was a successful hunt! Come, give me the jelly and then leave! I still have important work to do.

Wizard2_Objective_1_Text.chinese: 给法师送去一份五彩胶冻。
Wizard2_Objective_1_Text.english: Deliver a portion of prismatic jelly to the Wizard.

Wizard2_Text.chinese: 我需要人手协助追查当地洞穴内罕见而危险的五彩史莱姆。给我拿一罐它的五彩胶冻来，你会得到应有的奖励的。——M·拉斯莫迪斯
Wizard2_Text.english: I need help tracking down the rare and dangerous prismatic slime in the local caves. Bring me a jar of its prismatic jelly, and you'll get the reward you deserve. -- M. Rasmodius

Wizard_Objective_0_Message.chinese: 啊，它充满了被遗忘的灵魂的能量……太完美了。$h#$b#现在你可以走了！我需要绝对的安静来辨别这种物质的真实性质。
Wizard_Objective_0_Message.english: Ah, it's full of the energy of forgotten souls... too perfect. Now you may leave! I need absolute quiet to discern this substance's true nature.

Wizard_Objective_0_Text.chinese: 给法师送去一份灵外质。
Wizard_Objective_0_Text.english: Deliver a portion of ectoplasm to the Wizard.

Wizard_Text.chinese: 我在寻找一种极为罕见的粘液，即所谓的“灵外质”，它有很强的力量，可以在杀死的鬼魂的遗骸中找到。——M·拉斯莫迪斯
Wizard_Text.english: I'm looking for an extremely rare slime, the so-called "ectoplasm"; it has great power, and can be found in the remains of killed ghosts. -- M. Rasmodius
